title: OrganizationalUnit
description: A unit of an Organization's internal structure: a division, department, team, office, branch, chapter, committee, faculty or anything else the organisation groups its people by. Units nest through `parentId` to any depth, and an organisation may have any number of top-level units, so flat, nested and federated structures all fit. Lives in the organisation's eVault and describes the structure as it is now: a unit that no longer exists is deleted, after its people and sub-units have moved. Who belongs to a unit is recorded separately, one OrganizationalUnitMembership per person. A unit grants no authority: signing authority comes only from Role and Delegation.

organizationEName.description: eName of the organisation's eVault. Must be the eName of the vault the record lives in.

name.description: The unit's name, e.g. 'Platform', 'North-West chapter', 'Finance committee'

kind.description: What the organisation calls this kind of unit, shown to people as is: 'Department', 'Division', 'Team', 'Office', 'Branch', 'Chapter', 'Committee', 'Circle', 'Faculty', 'Programme'. Free text: different organisations use different words. Absent means 'Department'.

code.description: A short code the organisation uses for the unit, such as a cost centre, fund or programme code ('ENG-PLAT', '4100')

description.description: What the unit does, in the organisation's own words

parentId.description: MetaEnvelope id of the parent OrganizationalUnit in the same vault. Left out for a top-level unit (never null: see the README on writing these records). Following parents must never come back to this unit.

headENames.description: Who leads the unit. Usually one person; several when the unit is led jointly (co-chairs, co-coordinators); empty while the post is vacant. A head need not be a member of this unit: an interim head may sit elsewhere.

headTitle.description: What the unit calls its head: 'Head', 'Manager', 'Director', 'Chair', 'Coordinator', 'Dean'. Absent means 'Head'.

position.description: Display order among units with the same parent, lowest first

createdAt.description: When the unit was first recorded

updatedAt.description: When this version of the record was written

authorization.description: Proof that the organisation authorised this change: the wallet signature (`w3ds-grant/v1`, over this record's canonical form) of someone holding the organisation's authority over its structure at `signedAt`. That is one of its directors (the `directors` of the vault's Company record, which every Organization has), or a person with a live Delegation in the same vault whose scopes include `ontology:9560e48d-0dd2-42f6-bcee-c0613eb07b64` (named by `delegationId`). A record without such a signature is not part of the organisation's structure, whichever platform wrote it. Readers check this; the eVault does not.

signerEName.description: eName of the director or delegate who signed this version

signedPayload.description: The exact canonical string that was signed

signature.description: The signer's wallet signature over signedPayload

signedAt.description: When it was signed; the signer's authority is judged at this time

delegationId.description: Present when the signer acts under a Delegation rather than as a director: MetaEnvelope id of that Delegation, in the same vault, with the scope `ontology:9560e48d-0dd2-42f6-bcee-c0613eb07b64`
